owner_gate: Root controller assigns a named owner before implementation/admission.

canonical_idea.title: Cross-fitted scalar calibration under the weighted metric

proposal.mechanism: For each target and fixed bins of an honest out-of-fold student score s, estimate the metric-weighted conditional mean E[M·|Y_c|·Y_c | s] / E[M·|Y_c| | s], where Y_c=clip(Y,−2,2) and M is the official scoring mask. Bin-level EDA is allowed now; fitting a calibration map is future-only on training folds, never grade components.
proposal.evidence_and_counterevidence: The weighted-mean geometry is exact for the official score, and positive affine transforms do nothing before clipping. Histogram MSE/CE were negative; this proposal is a low-dimensional scalar post-map, not another codebook head, and has no measured gain.
proposal.prior_overlap: New narrow candidate from R3; overlaps histogram calibration enough that the exact old arm and held-out component protocol must be checked first.
proposal.no_fit_gate: Inspect existing frozen-checkpoint outputs if available; bounded inference of a frozen checkpoint is allowed under the contract if needed. Plot only predeclared weighted bin means, support, and component stability; do not fit a calibration map now or tune on grade components.
proposal.additional_gate: The score-map equation and bins must be reviewed and frozen before fitting; calibration maps are cross-fit on training folds only and never trained on grade components.
proposal.falsifier: Defer if the curve is affine, sparse, unstable, or no separately graded components improve under the later authorized map.
proposal.future_control: CP30: identity readout versus per-target cross-fitted map, with map fit only on training folds and score measured on disjoint exposed components.
proposal.compute_and_cpu_path: Low offline CPU cost; two tiny tables run statelessly after a CPU student. Calibrate the student’s own outputs, not a mismatched teacher.

fit_budget.ancillary_job_gate: List and resource-account every teacher, pretraining, cache or calibration fit outside the endpoint matrix before admission.

cell_matrix.membership_gate: Bind the existing source-qualified F0-F3 fitting/evaluation membership artifacts and hashes; do not create row splits or imply the folds are fresh.

data.source_gate: Bind exact supplied file paths, sizes and SHA-256 before any run.
data.feature_semantics: Anonymized features; use documented groups only. `seq_ix` can identify reset boundaries but is not an input feature.
data.transform_fit_scope: Training membership only; all state/statistics reset per sequence and use past/current inputs only.
forbidden: future labels or targets as inference inputs

metric_and_uncertainty.name: global_wp_clip2_v1
metric_and_uncertainty.official_mask: need_prediction AND is_scored on scored evaluation rows; training supervision uses permitted need_prediction rows
metric_and_uncertainty.per_target: unchanged official clipping at +/-2 and original clipped-label magnitude weights; compute separately for both targets, then average according to the official scorer
metric_and_uncertainty.primary_statistic: D = (1/4) * sum over F0..F3 of the fold mean of paired candidate-minus-control WP deltas; each fold mean averages its available 8/8/7/7 seed pairs; WP is scored for each complete outer endpoint, not averaged across model seeds first

seed_bootstrap.method: bootstrap the eight seed identities with replacement; use the same sampled seed multiplicities across all four fixed folds; for each replicate renormalize over available seed cells in each fold and average the four fold means equally; redraw if any fold has zero effective seed multiplicity
seed_bootstrap.scope: approximate fitting-seed interval conditional on four exposed folds, fixed data, memberships and ancestry; eight identities are few and do not represent unseen regime uncertainty

metric_and_uncertainty.evaluation_unit_uncertainty: Separate fixed-prediction paired resampling of source-qualified components within each fold, using identical component multiplicities for both arms and all seeds; no fold resampling. Exact component manifests and RNG details are null pending binding.
metric_and_uncertainty.exposure: All current panels are exposed development data; this plan does not create a fresh holdout or estimate unseen public score.
metric_and_uncertainty.multiplicity: If selecting among the 25 portfolio arms for a formal claim, freeze the family and multiplicity procedure before outcomes; exploratory intervals alone are not confirmatory.

training_configuration.precision: strict FP32 for weights, activations, state, gradients and optimizer; autocast/GradScaler off; TF32 off; float32 matmul precision highest
training_configuration.configuration_gate: Bind all values, train-only selection rule, seed behavior and resume policy identically across paired arms before admission.

ancestry.gate: Resolve research-team base and record exact sources, membership, hashes and transitive teacher/initializer/cache ancestry; evaluation components must be excluded from every fitted ancestor.

compute.gate: No hardware or duration measurement is claimed; profile the actual pathway and record a resource admission before a future run.

commands.training_command_gate: No trainer/adapters/cache bindings are implemented in this proposal; an exact runnable training command must be added only after implementation review and explicit training authority.
commands.validation_scope: JSON syntax only. This command does not validate scientific binding and does not train, fit, infer, profile or score.
